data.title: San Andreas Fault Jeep Tour from Palm Springs
highlights: Open-air Jeep ride through the San Andreas Fault zone
Guide-led geology interpretation at key viewpoints
Stops near desert washes and fan-palm oasis habitat
notIncluded: Hotel pickup and drop-off unless selected

itinerary.title: Meet at Desert Adventures base
itinerary.description: Check in and receive a quick terrain and safety briefing before departure.

faqs.question: How long is the San Andreas Fault Jeep Tour from Palm Springs?
faqs.answer: The guided tour duration is approximately 3 hours, including transportation and interpretive stops.
